posts.name: Pritish Bhapkar
posts.cooked:
Hello,

I have a concern regarding the Biweekly Practice Tests (BPT) for the system commands course.

Due to some login issues and project commitments, I forgot to submit the first two BPTs. I recently received an email stating the eligibility criteria for the end term exam: an average score of at least 40/100 from the best 7 out of the first 9 weekly assessments (objective and programming) and successfully attempting at least 3 out of the first 4 BPTs.

Upon checking the grading document, I see that there are 5 BPTs scheduled as follows: June 15, June 29, July 13, July 27, and August 10, 2024.

My concern is:

  1. If I submit the last 3 BPTs, will I still be eligible for the end term exam?
  2. The first two BPTs are still accessible, and I can submit them even though the deadline has passed. If I provide correct answers, will these submissions count towards my eligibility?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Pritish

Now I will complete remaining 3 BPT within stipulated time frame.

I missed the initial BPT notifications for the System Commands course due to my heavy course load, projects, and a full-time internship. I only saw the BPT 3 email recently and realized that we need to complete 3 out of 4 BPTs to qualify for the end-term exam.

I suggest updating future BPT notifications in the announcement section or clearly on the portal since many students, including myself, miss these emails due to the high volume.

I assure you I will complete the remaining BPTs. Please consider making an exception this one time to allow students like me and many more who didn’t attempt last 2 BPTs to meet the criteria with just 2 BPTs instead of 3 or consider any 3 BPTs from 5 BPTs so can become eligible.
